day_shape: 91 items: CENTCOM confirms fresh overnight US strikes on southern Iran over Strait of Hormuz shipping, Bahrain sirens and Gulf-wide alerts, Khamenei funeral procession staged in Mashhad, State Dept begins rescinding Syria's SST designation, Tehran and London trade ambassador summonses.

threads.label: US strikes Iran over Hormuz shipping
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced additional strikes on Iran to degrade its ability to threaten Strait of Hormuz navigation, with explosions reported in southern coastal provinces and sirens sounding in Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar. Trump said he would 'probably hit Iran tonight' after the NATO Ankara summit, and Jerusalem Post reported the White House is preparing for a possible weeks-long conflict.

threads.label: Iranian response and diplomacy
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry condemned the US strikes on southern coastal provinces and railway bridges as violating the 'understanding memorandum', while Trump claimed Iran had called wanting a deal and Macron said Tehran violated its agreement by hitting Gulf bases. Iran International reported an internal split in Tehran between factions pursuing diplomacy and those pushing confrontation.

threads.label: Mashhad funeral procession for Khamenei
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted a sustained cycle of tier-4 coverage of the arrival at Shahid Hashemi-Nejad Airport of a plane carrying the body of the 'martyred leader of the revolution', with a 14:00 procession on a 4km stretch of Imam Reza Street. Regime channels claimed 3,000 mourning tents, 750 medical teams, and the presence of Pakistani pilgrims; Khamenei's office issued messages vowing vengeance.

threads.label: UK-Iran ambassador summonses
threads.summary: Iran summoned the British ambassador in Tehran two days after London called in Iran's most senior diplomat over the conviction of two Romanian men for the stabbing of an Iran International journalist. Defa Press said Iran had communicated its protest over 'baseless accusations' regarding anti-security measures in Britain.

threads.label: Syria SST designation rescission
threads.summary: Secretary Rubio announced Trump had notified Congress of intent to rescind Syria's State Sponsor of Terrorism designation after a 45-day pre-notification period, following his meeting with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. Trump added Damascus could help with Hezbollah and Lebanon, and Jerusalem Post reported Saudi Arabia is seeking to reroute IMEC through Syria, bypassing Israel.

threads.label: Israel-Lebanon and IDF operations
threads.summary: Defense Minister Israel Katz rejected Trump's claim that Israel would withdraw from Lebanon, saying troops would remain in security zones as long as needed. The IDF said a Radwan Force operative was captured by the 679th 'Yiftah' Brigade in Bint Jbeil, and 20 suspects were arrested overnight across the West Bank.

threads.label: Iran January crackdown victim profiles
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post published a series of interviews and profiles remembering individuals killed by Iranian security forces during the January anti-regime protests, including Adel Matlabnejad, Rasoul Ziaei, Taha Naderi, Mehdi Eskandarian, Mani Yousefi, Mostafa Adgarsalehi, Ermia Lachiani and Abolfazl Jahedi. Iran International reported twelve protesters in Isfahan face imminent execution after the Supreme Court upheld death sentences over the alleged killing of four Basij members.

events.title_en: A look at the wall inscriptions at Tehran's Mosalla; the handwritten notes of the people and walls that have become the 'oral history' of these days in Iran
events.summary_en: A look at the wall inscriptions at Tehran's Mosalla; the handwritten notes of the people and walls that have become the 'oral history' of these days in Iran. An elderly woman holding a flag slowly entered the courtyard of the Mosalla. She had placed her hand on one of the concrete walls and was reciting Fatiha. The walls had been placed to separate the area for farewell between women and men. Each of these walls in itself is the oral history of these days in Iran. Margin note: Ibrahim Asadi Bidmeshki - correspondent

events.title_en: Farewell to the martyred imam at the Razavi shrine; the servant of the sun returns to the embrace of the shrine
events.summary_en: Farewell to the martyred imam at the Razavi shrine; the servant of the sun returns to the embrace of the shrine. The funeral procession of the body of the martyred leader of the ummah will formally begin at 14:00 today in the holy city of Mashhad with the presence of large crowds of devoted followers of the martyred imam. Mourning people from Islamic Iran from various provinces of the country, particularly from the southern, eastern and western provinces, have travelled to the holy city of Mashhad to participate in the funeral and burial ceremony of the martyred imam, which will begin at 14:00 today from Imam Reza Street, to accompany Iran's 'martyred master' to his eternal resting place in the shrine of the Sun of Suns.
